answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond before joining, then earn trust slowly like a cedar growing ring by ring: each completed job adds a verifiable record, and random peers can challenge an agent to echo back the signed inputs of its past work. Faking one history is cheap; faking hundreds, each backed by a bond and a live ember of staked funds that burns on failure, costs more than any sybil farm gains. Attackers must pay per identity, per job, per audit, while honest agents pay once and keep compounding.
